steps.thought: List the available tests to understand the station's capabilities and find the cheapest way to scan subsystems.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest to quickly check all communication buses and subsystem enumeration.
steps.observation: The power_on_selftest passed completely, verifying that all four CAN nodes, the camera controller, the IMU, and the compass are correctly enumerated and communicating during boot.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial boot selftest passed without any failures, though further testing of other subsystems is still required.
Boot test passed, but motor mechanical and dynamic performance have not been tested yet.
Boot test passed, but battery under load needs verification.
Boot test passed, but compass static and dynamic checks are pending.
Camera controller enumerated successfully, but camera image quality and CSI errors require a dedicated test.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_rest_check to verify pack and per-cell voltages at rest as the next low-cost subsystem test.
steps.observation: battery_rest_check failed with a cell imbalance of 0.076 V, which exceeds the limit of 0.030 V. This rules out a healthy battery and strongly points towards a weak cell.

hypotheses.rationale: Rest cell imbalance of 0.076 V significantly exceeds the 0.030 V limit, pointing directly to a weak cell in the battery pack.
Motor has not been tested yet, but primary current symptoms point to battery subsystem.
Compass has not been fully tested yet.

steps.thought: To confirm the weak battery cell diagnosis and evaluate the overall pack condition under load, I will run the battery_load_test. This is the most direct way to check for voltage sag and internal resistance issues related to cell imbalance.
steps.observation: The battery_load_test confirmed a severe loaded cell imbalance of 0.369 V (limit 0.060 V) with cell 3 dropping significantly under load to 3.599 V, conclusively proving a weak cell in the battery pack.

hypotheses.rationale: Both rest and load cell imbalances greatly exceed limits, with cell 3 showing excessive voltage sag compared to the other cells.
Internal resistance is slightly elevated, but the primary mode is clearly a single weak cell causing massive imbalance.

steps.thought: The battery tests clearly show a weak cell (cell 3) causing severe cell imbalance both at rest and under load, confirming the root cause. I will now propose replacing the battery pack.
